name: HBG Hotels Limited
about: HBG HOTELS LIMITED owns and operates hotels and resorts in India. The company operates the Phoenix Island Resort located in Poovar, Kerala; the Phoenix Castle House located in Palolem, Goa; and the Park Inn by Radisson located in Candolim, Goa. HBG HOTELS LIMITED was formerly known as Phoenix Township Limited and changed its name to HBG HOTELS LIMITED in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
